usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.projects.groups.list("project_id", limit: 20, after: "after", order: "asc")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.admin.organization.projects.groups.list(project_id, limit: nil, after: nil, order: nil) -> Page<Models::ProjectGroup>

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of project groups to return. Defaults to 20.

fields.name: after
fields.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the ID of the last group from the previous response to fetch the next page.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for the returned groups.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Identifier of the group that has access to the project.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the group was granted project access.
